caption: The drawing depicts a single, medium-sized jug centrally positioned within a large, light beige rectangular background, outlined by a faint pencil border. The jug is rendered in shades of olive green and brown with subtle highlights and shadows to convey a metallic surface. It features a vertically ribbed body and a broad wavy rim. The handle, attached at the top and base, is curved and extends from the upper body of the jug. In the bottom left corner of the main rectangle, there is a separate, smaller rectangular section showing a detailed side view of the jug’s handle, also in olive green and brown tones. The artist’s name, "Francis Law Durand," appears in small capitals in the bottom right corner of the large background.
title: Pitcher
